title: Ravi and the Lost Conch
description: Ravi, a curious Indian boy, discovers a mysterious conch on the beach and embarks on an adventure to return it to the ocean spirit.

scenes.description: Ravi walking along the golden beach collecting seashells.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, brown shorts, barefoot, walking along golden sandy beach, gentle ocean waves in background, warm sunset light, storybook style)
scenes.narration: Ravi loved exploring the beach every evening, hoping to find rare seashells for his growing collection.
scenes.subtitle: Ravi loved exploring the beach every evening, hoping to find rare seashells.

scenes.description: Ravi spots a glowing conch half-buried in the sand.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy kneeling on golden sandy beach, brushing sand off a glowing spiral conch, soft ocean waves in background, warm orange sunset light, storybook style)
scenes.narration: One day, he noticed a strange glow under the sand. Curious, he dug gently and uncovered a shimmering golden conch.
scenes.subtitle: One day, he noticed a strange glow under the sand and uncovered a golden conch.

scenes.description: Ravi holds the conch to his ear and hears a faint voice calling for help.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy holding glowing spiral conch to his ear, eyes wide in surprise, ocean waves shimmering behind, warm sunset glow, storybook style)
scenes.narration: When Ravi held it close, he heard a soft voice pleading, ‘Please… take me home to the Coral Palace.’
scenes.subtitle: When Ravi held it close, he heard a soft voice pleading, ‘Please… take me home.’

scenes.description: Ravi wades into the water, holding the conch carefully.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy wading into shallow turquoise water, holding glowing spiral conch with both hands, gentle waves, horizon glowing with sunset, storybook style)
scenes.narration: Knowing the ocean was calling, Ravi stepped into the water, determined to help the mysterious voice.
scenes.subtitle: Knowing the ocean was calling, Ravi stepped into the water, determined to help.

scenes.description: A majestic sea turtle appears to guide Ravi.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, large friendly sea turtle emerging from the water in front of little Indian boy holding glowing conch, golden sunlight on water, storybook style)
scenes.narration: Suddenly, a great sea turtle appeared. ‘Follow me,’ it said, ‘I’ll take you to the Coral Palace.’
scenes.subtitle: Suddenly, a great sea turtle appeared. ‘Follow me,’ it said.

scenes.description: Ravi returns the conch to a glowing coral structure underwater.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy underwater with friendly sea turtle, placing glowing spiral conch on a radiant coral palace, colorful fish swimming around, beams of sunlight filtering through water, storybook style)
scenes.narration: They swam together to a glowing coral palace, where Ravi gently placed the conch back in its rightful place.
scenes.subtitle: They swam to a glowing coral palace, where Ravi placed the conch back.

scenes.description: The ocean rewards Ravi with a pearl as thanks.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy standing back on golden beach, holding a shiny pearl, ocean waves behind him, warm evening light, storybook style)
scenes.narration: As a thank you, the ocean gave Ravi a shining pearl — a reminder that kindness always finds its way back.
scenes.subtitle: The ocean gave Ravi a shining pearl — kindness always comes back.
